hooks.command: bash -c 'i=$(cat); case $i in *"pr merge"*|*"/merge"*|*mergePullRequest*|*PullRequestAutoMerge*) m=1 ;; *update-branch*) m=0 ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; d=${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}; t=$(command -v timeout || command -v gtimeout); if [ "$m" = 1 ] && [ -n "$t" ]; then "$t" 10 git -C "$d" fetch --quiet --no-tags origin feat-cmux-next 2>/dev/null; fi; f=$(mktemp) || exit 1; trap "rm -f -- \"$f\"" EXIT; if ! git -C "$d" show origin/feat-cmux-next:scripts/ci/guards-from-base.sh > "$f" 2>/dev/null; then why="cmux guards: cannot read scripts/ci/guards-from-base.sh at origin/feat-cmux-next, so the merge guards did not run; fetch origin feat-cmux-next and retry"; if [ "$m" = 1 ]; then g=$HOME/.claude/hooks/require-cmux-guards.sh; if [ -f "$g" ]; then o=$(printf %s "$i" | bash "$g" 2>/dev/null); if python3 -I -c "import json, sys; a = json.loads(sys.argv[1]); s = a.get(\"hookSpecificOutput\") or a; sys.exit(0 if isinstance(s, dict) and s.get(\"permissionDecision\") == \"deny\" else 1)" "$o" 2>/dev/null; then printf "%s\n" "$o"; exit 0; fi; fi; printf "{\"systemMessage\": \"%s; merging anyway\", \"hookSpecificOutput\": {\"hookEventName\": \"PreToolUse\", \"additionalContext\": \"%s; merging anyway\"}}\n" "$why" "$why"; exit 0; fi; echo "$why" >&2; exit 1; fi; printf %s "$i" | bash "$f" "$d" || exit 1'
